LanguageData.RPD_ReleaseNotice_Body:
This release contains important changes. Back up your saves before continuing.
The Workshop mod is usually under your Steam library at steamapps\workshop\content\294100\3619548407. Your Steam library may be on another drive.
A local copy does not inherit the Workshop mod's settings. Before switching, back up your persona library, assignment rules, and built-in prompts. The library export includes only the first two; save the built-in prompts separately.
An older DLL is included with this mod. To roll back, first copy the entire mod to a local mod. In that local copy, replace Assemblies/RPD.dll with Backup/RPD.dll. Then enable only the local copy, not the Workshop version as well.
Do not edit the Workshop files directly. A save written by the new version may not be fully readable by the older DLL.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_EnableTip: Master switch for Auto-Gen, persona history, Auto-Evolve, and role-change features. Turning it off immediately invalidates pending optional work and keeps the stable core behavior.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_EnableConfirm: Optional features are isolated from the stable core but have less runtime coverage. Enable them?
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_CoreMode: Compatibility mode: only the stable core is active.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_PatchRegistrationFailed: Optional feature patches could not be registered.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_UnpatchFailed: Optional feature patches could not be fully removed. Restart the game to complete safe mode.
LanguageData.RPD_History_MaxRecordsTip: Maximum history records per pawn; 0 removes the record-count limit.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_InternalPromptNotice: Both modes share the advanced preset; otherwise each uses its built-in prompt.
